items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Lorenzo Stahl, he was with Jack Carey, he was playing manager.

ctx.x: Robichaux, well anybody around here tell him, he's younger than any of us too. But I do believe he did. We all called him Robichaux, see because I went to his house one time to get him to play. And he said that we should whistle for musicians, like that. So his old mother, somebody come to the door and said, what dog are you calling? I said Robichaux. Boy I point up, I said Robichaux. So he come to the door and say old man, I said yeah I am, I said I'm feeling no mind. So you know it's one of them things you…
Boy he made Robichaux for a boy cry like a baby. That's true for me to God ever. Did you read with those bands like Ernest Johnson? No. Did you read with Jack Carey?
